This comment describes what the WORKFLOW_LOG_FORK_EXCLUDED diagnostic log line contains, but the code does NOT actually strip workflow_name or workflow_path from the row.

  PROBLEM: 15+ existing test_* functions had "event": "push" added to their run dictionaries.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

  WHY: The CI coverage command runs the file as `__main__`, so `main()` cannot include tests defined after its invocation.

The daily scheduled path calls it with all `run_rows` at 2191-2194, independently of the filtered log selectors. Matching fork-origin runs can therefore have their archives downloaded and forge `GH_PAT_BUDGET` readings that enter the daily ranking.
